SELECT
    sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2008) AS Sales2008,
    sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2009) AS Sales2009,
    Sales2009 - Sales2008 AS AbsoluteGrowth,
    (Sales2009 - Sales2008) / Sales2008 * 100 AS GrowthPercent
FROM retail.FactSales
WHERE StoreKey IN (
    SELECT StoreKey
    FROM retail.FactSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) IN (2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY StoreKey
    HAVING countDistinct(toYear(DateKey)) = 2
)
AND toYear(DateKey) IN (2008, 2009)
